    - text: CLASS 12 · PROBABILITY
    - heading "Probability Distribution of a Random Variable" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Learn how outcome probabilities combine for each numeric value and must form a valid distribution.
    - text: 18 min · BUILD · CHART · VALIDATE · EXAMPLES · PRACTICE
    - navigation "Lesson sections":
      - button "Build"
      - button "Chart"
      - button "Validate"
      - button "Examples"
      - button "Practice"
    - heading "1 Map outcomes → values (two fair coin tosses)" [level=2]
    - button "Reset":
      - img
      - text: Reset
    - paragraph: X = number of heads. Drag or click an outcome to see how its probability flows to the value bin.
    - article:
      - heading "All outcomes (each with probability 1/4)" [level=3]
      - button "Outcome TT":
        - text: T T TT 0 heads
        - strong: 1/4
      - button "Outcome HT" [pressed]:
        - text: H T HT 1 head
        - strong: 1/4
      - button "Outcome TH":
        - text: T H TH 1 head
        - strong: 1/4
      - button "Outcome HH":
        - text: H H HH 2 heads
        - strong: 1/4
    - article:
      - heading "Value bins (X = number of heads)" [level=3]
      - heading "X = 0" [level=4]
      - paragraph: (0 heads)
      - text: 1 outcome
      - strong: TT
      - paragraph: Total P = 1/4
      - heading "X = 1" [level=4]
      - paragraph: (1 head)
      - text: 2 outcomes
      - strong: HT, TH
      - paragraph: Total P = 1/2
      - heading "X = 2" [level=4]
      - paragraph: (2 heads)
      - text: 1 outcome
      - strong: HH
      - paragraph: Total P = 1/4
    - status: HT contributes to X = 1, together with TH.
    - article:
      - heading "2 Probability distribution (PMF)" [level=2]
      - paragraph: p(x) is the probability that X takes value x.
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "x Contributing outcomes p(x) Cumulative P(X ≤ x)":
            - columnheader "x"
            - columnheader "Contributing outcomes"
            - columnheader "p(x)"
            - columnheader "Cumulative P(X ≤ x)"
        - rowgroup:
          - row "0 TT 0.25 0.25":
            - cell "0"
            - cell "TT"
            - cell "0.25"
            - cell "0.25"
          - row "1 HT, TH 0.5 0.75":
            - cell "1"
            - cell "HT, TH"
            - cell "0.5"
            - cell "0.75"
          - row "2 HH 0.25 1":
            - cell "2"
            - cell "HH"
            - cell "0.25"
            - cell "1"
        - rowgroup:
          - row "Sum 1 (valid) —":
            - rowheader "Sum"
            - cell "1 (valid)"
            - cell "—"
      - paragraph: P(0 ≤ X ≤ 1) = p(0) + p(1) = 0.75
    - article:
      - heading "3 Probability mass function (theory)" [level=2]
      - text: Theoretical P(X = x) Empirical (no trials yet)
      - group "Probability bars for X equal to zero, one and two": P(X = x) 0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1 0.25 0 0.5 1 0.25 2 x (number of heads)
      - complementary:
        - text: Design mode
        - switch "Design mode"
        - paragraph:
          - img
          - text: Locked Fair coins (theory)
        - heading "Simulate trials" [level=3]
        - button "20"
        - button "100"
        - button "1000" [pressed]
        - button "Run 1000 trials":
          - img
          - text: Run 1000 trials
        - heading "Empirical results" [level=3]
        - paragraph: No trials yet
    - heading "4 Validate your distribution" [level=2]
    - article:
      - heading "Non-negativity" [level=3]:
        - img
        - text: Non-negativity
      - paragraph: Each p(x) ≥ 0
      - strong: All good
    - article:
      - heading "Total probability" [level=3]
      - paragraph: ∑ p(x) = 1
      - progressbar "Total probability mass"
      - strong: Sum = 1
    - article:
      - heading "Validity status" [level=3]
      - img
      - strong: Valid distribution
      - paragraph: Ready to use!
    - article:
      - heading "Definition" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "A probability mass function p(x) for a discrete random variable X satisfies:"
      - paragraph: p(x) ≥ 0 for every value x.
      - paragraph: ∑ p(x) = 1 (total probability is 1).
      - paragraph: p(x) is the probability that X takes the value x.
    - article:
      - heading "Common misconception" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: Common misconception
      - text: The bars need not be equal.
      - paragraph: They can be different heights, but their values must add up to 1.
      - img "Valid unequal example, sum 1"
      - strong: "Valid: sum 1"
      - img "Invalid example, sum 0.4"
      - strong: "Invalid: sum 0.4"
    - article:
      - heading "Worked example" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Two fair coin tosses. X = number of heads.
      - paragraph: "Outcomes: TT, HT, TH, HH (each 1/4)"
      - paragraph: "X values: 0, 1, 2"
      - paragraph: "PMF: P(X = 0) = 1/4, P(X = 1) = 1/2, P(X = 2) = 1/4"
      - paragraph: P(0 ≤ X ≤ 1) = 3/4 = 0.75
    - heading "Quick practice" [level=2]
    - paragraph: A bag contains 2 red and 1 blue ball. One ball is drawn at random. Let Y = 1 if red, 0 if blue. Choose the correct PMF.
    - group "Options:":
      - text: "Options:"
      - radio "P(Y=1)=2/3, P(Y=0)=1/3"
      - text: P(Y=1)=2/3, P(Y=0)=1/3
      - radio "P(Y=1)=1/3, P(Y=0)=2/3"
      - text: P(Y=1)=1/3, P(Y=0)=2/3
      - radio "P(Y=1)=1/2, P(Y=0)=1/2"
      - text: P(Y=1)=1/2, P(Y=0)=1/2
      - radio "P(Y=1)=3/4, P(Y=0)=1/4"
      - text: P(Y=1)=3/4, P(Y=0)=1/4
